# NextGen Chartered Accountant

> NextGen Chartered Accountant is a UK firm of Chartered Accountants based in Luton, England. It is an ICAEW member firm (firm number C011010236), founded and led by Sheryar Ahmed ACA FCCA. It works online with small businesses, limited companies, contractors, landlords and the self-employed across the United Kingdom, and with non-residents who have UK tax or company obligations. Fees are fixed and published. It is not connected with Accounts NextGen (Australia) or NextGen Accountants (New Zealand).

## Key facts
- Name: NextGen Chartered Accountant (also written NextGen Chartered Accountants, NextGen CA)
- Website: https://nextgenca.co.uk/
- Type: firm of Chartered Accountants, sole practitioner, ICAEW member firm number C011010236
- Founder: Sheryar Ahmed ACA FCCA. Practice Manager: Fiza Gillani ACCA
- Based in: Luton, Bedfordshire, England. No London office. Works online with clients anywhere in the UK and abroad
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9am to 7pm UK time. Enquiries answered within 1 hour in those hours
- Pricing: fixed starting fees, published. Not VAT registered, so no VAT is added
- Software: Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, FreeAgent, Dext
- Verify: https://find.icaew.com/firms/luton/nextgen/Z1qgR7E

## Latest tax and Companies House updates
- [Companies House identity verification one year on: what to do if a director has still not verified](https://nextgenca.co.uk/insights/companies-house-identity-verification-one-year-on-missed-deadline): The 12-month transition for existing directors ended on 17 November 2026. Companies House says enforcement is under way, with warning letters, prosecutions and planned notes on the public register.
- [Payroll bureaus must register with HMRC as tax advisers by 17 February 2027](https://nextgenca.co.uk/insights/tax-adviser-registration-payroll-professionals-deadline-17-february-2027): Phase three of HMRC's tax adviser registration is open. Professionals who only provide payroll services for clients and do not have an agent services account must register by midnight on 17 February 2027.
- [Self Assessment scams: how to spot a fake HMRC message before 31 January](https://nextgenca.co.uk/insights/self-assessment-scams-how-to-spot-a-fake-hmrc-message): HMRC has had 1,704 reports of Self Assessment scams in the last 12 months. Here is how the fake refund scams work and what HMRC will never do.
- [Payroll deadlines every month: FPS on or before payday, pay HMRC by the 22nd](https://nextgenca.co.uk/insights/payroll-deadlines-fps-on-payday-pay-hmrc-by-22nd): Running payroll means two HMRC deadlines every tax month. Here is the calendar, from payday to the 22nd, and what happens if you miss it.
- [VAT return deadline: one month and 7 days after each quarter, and the penalty points system](https://nextgenca.co.uk/insights/vat-return-deadline-one-month-and-seven-days): Your VAT return and payment are due by the same date. How the deadline works, why weekends do not count, and how late returns earn penalty points.
- [Company accounts: due 9 months after your year end, and the late filing penalties](https://nextgenca.co.uk/insights/company-accounts-deadline-9-months-and-late-filing-penalties): Companies House expects your accounts 9 months after the financial year ends (21 months for first accounts). Penalties start at £150 and double if you are late two years running.
- [Corporation tax: pay 9 months and 1 day after your year end, file the CT600 within 12 months](https://nextgenca.co.uk/insights/corporation-tax-pay-9-months-1-day-file-ct600-12-months): The tax is due before the return. The two corporation tax deadlines, the late filing penalties, and what happens after 6 months.
- [Start your 2025 to 2026 tax return now: five things to check before 31 January](https://nextgenca.co.uk/insights/start-your-self-assessment-tax-return-now): Around 5 million people leave their tax return until January. Here are the points worth checking now, including the Winter Fuel Payment, Child Benefit and crypto gains.
- [HMRC late payment interest rises to 8% from 24 November 2026](https://nextgenca.co.uk/insights/hmrc-late-payment-interest-rises-to-8-percent): The Bank of England raised base rate to 4.00%, so HMRC's interest on late tax goes up to 8% a year. Here is what it means for anyone with a tax bill due on 31 January.
- [Making Tax Digital for Income Tax: five myths, and the next deadline on 7 February](https://nextgenca.co.uk/insights/making-tax-digital-income-tax-myths-and-next-deadline): Quarterly updates are not tax returns and no tax is paid with them. What sole traders and landlords in MTD need to know before the third update.
- [National Living Wage rises to £13.21 from April 2027: what employers should do now](https://nextgenca.co.uk/insights/national-living-wage-april-2027-employers): The minimum wage goes up for every age group on 1 April 2027. Here are the new rates and the payroll checks worth doing before then.
- [Landlords and savers: new 24%, 44% and 49% income tax rates from 6 April 2027](https://nextgenca.co.uk/insights/property-and-savings-income-tax-rates-24-44-49-from-april-2027): Budget 2026 introduced separate income tax rates for property and savings income. From 6 April 2027 they will be 24% basic, 44% higher and 49% additional rate.
- [Trading allowance to rise from £1,000 to £3,000 from April 2027](https://nextgenca.co.uk/insights/trading-allowance-rises-to-3000-from-april-2027): Budget 2026 confirmed the trading allowance will triple to £3,000 from the 2027 to 2028 tax year, with the Self Assessment reporting threshold for this income rising to £3,000 too.
- [Companies House: all accounts must be filed through software from April 2028](https://nextgenca.co.uk/insights/companies-house-accounts-software-filing-from-april-2028): Small companies will not have to file a profit and loss account after all, but web and paper filing of accounts will close in April 2028.
- [Objecting to a company being struck off: online only from 1 December 2026](https://nextgenca.co.uk/insights/companies-house-strike-off-objections-online-from-1-december): If a customer's company owes you money and is about to be struck off, Companies House will stop accepting objections by email from 1 December 2026. Here is how the online service works and what evidence you need.
